title: shrink: five production modules remain above the 1,500-line source limit
fix: Split the evaluation router, LLM provider/capability paths, worker concerns, ReAct loop, and ChatView into smaller cohesive modules; keep the existing line-guard cap as the enforcement boundary and reduce each baseline before adding features.

title: README documents seed admin username sj while the copied env example sets admin
fix: Make README, `.env.example`, and the migration default use one documented username, then add a clean-clone assertion for the first-login credentials.

title: shrink: the suite has no true full-stack E2E path; Playwright mocks every API and backend E2E tests use in-memory SQLite plus mocked LLM calls
fix: Add a CI disposable-stack test that drives a browser or HTTP client through the real nginx/backend/Redis path for signup, submit, and chat; stub only the upstream model at a controlled provider boundary and assert persisted state plus rendered completion.

title: The default backend suite is not green: the no-proxy full run reported 37 failed, 2,799 passed, 4 skipped, and 14 deselected tests, while the check script records this path as non-blocking
fix: Cluster and repair the failing regressions, publish the failure list in CI, and restore the full suite as a blocking gate once the baseline is zero.

title: DNS/IP validation is performed once before the HTTP client resolves the user-configured upstream again, leaving an SSRF DNS-rebinding gap
fix: Pin the validated address in the transport or enforce an egress proxy/host allowlist that revalidates at connect time; keep redirects disabled and add a rebinding regression test.

title: App and nginx images do not declare a non-root USER; the app and nginx master process still start as root before/around the runtime handoff
fix: Make the runtime user explicit; move bind-mount permission repair to deployment setup or use a non-root nginx listener, and add an image inspection gate for effective UID.

title: The user-scoped public-contribution list loads the whole table and filters requester_id in Python, so work grows with every tenant
fix: Push requester_id into the service SQL WHERE clause and add the supporting composite index and pagination.

title: A user can create an unbounded number of active public-contribution requests and grow the admin review queue
fix: Count active requests per requester inside the create transaction and enforce a bounded limit with a regression test.

title: The mission-critical OAuth gateway and nginx services expose no Compose healthcheck, so an auth/edge failure is not surfaced as unhealthy
fix: Add healthchecks for OAuth /health and the nginx serving path, then make dependent monitoring and deployment checks consume those statuses.

title: The runbook set covers backup, eval worker, and secret rotation but has no operator recipes for DB/Redis outage, upstream LLM 5xx or rate limits, disk exhaustion, or OOM
fix: Add symptom, alert, diagnosis, containment, rollback, and verification steps for the missing failure classes and link them from the deployment entrypoint.

title: The separately deployed OAuth gateway uses unconstrained requirements and has no lockfile or dedicated dependency audit path
fix: Pin and hash the gateway dependency set with a committed lock artifact, and run its audit in CI alongside the root uv and npm locks.

title: The blocking line guard is red again: admin_evaluation.py, worker.py, and ChatView.vue exceed their frozen baseline caps
fix: Split or shrink the three files back under their recorded caps before raising any override; keep the guard blocking in CI.

title: Static typing is not a reliable gate: mypy currently reports 551 errors, frontend has no strict TypeScript or type-check script, and both paths are non-blocking
fix: Reduce the mypy baseline, enable strict TypeScript incrementally, add tsc --noEmit, and make the stabilized checks blocking in CI.

title: The generated schema document stops at migration 086 while the live migration registry now reaches 117, so migration and destructive-change documentation is stale
fix: Regenerate schema.md from the current migration head and add a CI freshness check after every migration change.

title: The subprocessor register names only a generic provider region and does not provide deployment-specific processing locations or transfer safeguards for configurable LLM/embedding providers
fix: Add an instance-specific data-flow matrix with legal entity, region, transfer mechanism, retention, and operator confirmation; require it before enabling a provider.

title: The destructive clear-db admin endpoint creates a backup and writes only generic logs, but does not persist admin identity, target, result, and backup metadata in a durable audit record
fix: Write a durable admin audit event in the same controlled operation with admin id, confirmation context, backup path, affected scope, result, and timestamp; add a failure-path test.

title: README claims the example is the complete variable list, but a source-to-example scan finds 62 referenced runtime variables absent from backend/.env.example
fix: Either document the complete supported variable surface with defaults/sensitivity, or narrow the README claim and provide a generated reference for internal tuning knobs.

title: JWT .env read failures are swallowed and treated like a missing secret, which can silently generate a new signing key and invalidate every existing session after restart
fix: Fail closed or log the read/parse error distinctly before generating; add a restart test for unreadable or malformed .env files.

title: Two prominent charts hard-code their light/dark porcelain colors instead of consuming the existing chart token module, leaving theme changes prone to drift
fix: Refactor both charts to consume chartTokens/porcelain() and add a source check forbidding duplicate palette literals in chart components.
